subject: ClearWave SE walkthrough & procurement readiness
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Kapoor <anita.kapoor@clearwave.com>, devops@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClearWave SE walkthrough & procurement readiness

Hi team,

Following up from yesterday's discovery call with ClearWave — they would like a technical walkthrough before procurement can sign off. Key asks from their side: network allowlist, demo runbook, and a brief checklist for security to review (SOC2 evidence link requested).

Proposed slots (ClearWave prefers PDT):
- Tue Apr 5, 10:00–11:30 (preferred)
- Wed Apr 6, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Apr 7, 09:00–10:30

Notes:
- We'll need an SE to present the runbook and confirm staging access.
- They want engineer-to-engineer time so please plan ~60–75 minutes demo + 15–30 minutes for procurement/security questions.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (draft M.A.P.)

Tessa — can you confirm availability for Apr 5/6/7 and whether we should include Mina on the call for onboarding? Marcus — can you confirm SE availability and whether you need any pre-work (staging creds, sample tenant) from ClearWave?

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Kapoor <anita.kapoor@clearwave.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave SE walkthrough & procurement readiness

Thanks Aditya — looping in Mina for onboarding context. Marcus, for planning: we should treat this as a runbook review + live demo targeted at their platform engineers. I recommend 90 minutes total to accommodate network/topology questions.

Availability (PDT):
- Apr 5: I am available 09:30–12:00 (fine for 10:00 start)
- Apr 6: out mid-afternoon (but available 13:00–14:30 if we compress)
- Apr 7: 08:30–11:00

Pre-work request for customer: please provide NAT/allowlist ranges and any proxy IPs so we can validate loadgen access. Anita — could your security/devops team send a quick CSV of IP ranges? We can hold an hour pre-call if Marcus needs to validate connectivity (we prefer to do that 24–48h before the demo).

Also: Marcus mentioned he has PTO the first week of April — if that's the case, can we confirm his availability? If not, Karthik Iyer can present the runbook; he knows the orchestration changes for the Redwood runtime.

Action items:
- Anita: CSV of allowlist / preferred slot
- Marcus / Karthik: confirm presenter + pre-call window
- Aditya: confirm whether procurement rep will join the live session or only post-demo follow-up

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Advocate
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-03-28T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave SE walkthrough & procurement readiness

Thanks — I can present but small update: I will be on PTO Apr 1–6 (returning Apr 7). I can do Apr 7 at 09:00 PDT (tight) but not Apr 5 or 6. If the customer strongly prefers Apr 5, Karthik can step in — he ran the proof-of-concept and knows the runbook.

Pre-call: I would like a 30-minute connectivity check 48 hours before the demo. We need an SSH-friendly port and the allowlist CSV (Anita) to validate staging access. Please include the staging hostnames or a temporary support user if possible.

I put together a short SE runbook outline in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSE-runbook — it has a proposed agenda and list of required artifacts.

If Karthik presents, I will do a quick handoff doc and be available asynchronously for any follow-ups (and cover any post-demo technical Qs when I return).

Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi all — thanks for the clear options. Procurement prefers to sit in on the live session but won't lead. Our devops lead confirmed the following:

Preferred slots (PDT):
- Apr 7, 09:00–10:30 (preferred)
- Apr 5, 10:00–11:30 (backup)

Attached is the network_allowlist.csv — it contains our NAT ranges and proxy IPs. We can provide a temporary support user for staging; I'll have the team create one and DM the credentials to Marcus / Karthik 48 hours before the demo.

Note: Apr 5 is a local holiday for several of our engineers; that is why Apr 7 is better. We can confirm the procurement PO timeline post-demo — procurement@clearwave.com will send a template PO if the runbook looks good.

Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (placeholder)

Thanks,
Anita Kapoor
Senior Platform Engineer
ClearWave, Inc.
